We work on split and window ACs

Wall-mounted split ACs and window ACs are the most common in Narasaraopet homes, and both are covered by every service on this page.

Not every cooling problem needs gas. Dirty filters, a blocked coil or an electrical fault can also cause poor cooling, so our technician inspects the AC first.

Do you repair split and window ACs?

Yes. We repair and service both split ACs and window ACs.

Do you provide AC gas filling?

Yes. We first check for leaks and other causes of poor cooling, then fill gas only if the AC actually needs it.

How do I know whether my AC needs gas filling?

Weak cooling, ice on the copper pipes or a hissing sound can point to low gas, but dirty filters and electrical faults cause similar symptoms. A technician needs to inspect the AC to confirm.

Do you provide AC servicing and cleaning?

Yes. Servicing covers filter cleaning, indoor unit cleaning and an outdoor unit check. Deep cleaning is also available.
